global_rules.style: Minimal strict metal: graphite/obsidian panels, thin steel/brass rails, rare ruby pins, no heavy ornament or dragon curls.
global_rules.content_rule: Runtime content, text, icons, portraits, controls and hit areas must remain inside declared content_rect_xywh only; metal rails, bevels, corner plates and ruby pins are forbidden zones.
global_rules.button_rule: Does not replace SCRUM-273 Red & Gold buttons. SCRUM-450 owns button redraw from references.
global_rules.runtime_rule: Design-source package only; Back-end integration must wire these as a distinct minimal_metal kit or promote them through a reviewed handoff.

ui_frame_minimal_metal_modal.role: Large modal/window frame for Settings, Codex, pause/result and large dialogs.
ui_frame_minimal_metal_modal.safe_zone_policy: Content only inside content_rect_xywh; borders, ruby pins, bevels and corner plates are forbidden zones.
ui_frame_minimal_metal_modal.suggested_runtime: StyleBoxTexture / NinePatchRect with tile center for generic surfaces; authored whole-image only when source rects are declared.
